# Only Foods

> > A comprehensive food reference guide covering varieties, nutrition, and culinary uses of foods from nuts and seeds to vegetables, fruits, wines, and herbs.

Only Foods provides detailed guides to food types, varieties, and characteristics with nutritional information and regional origins. The site serves as an alphabetical food reference with pictures and categorized food profiles spanning produce, proteins, oils, and beverages.

## Key Topics

- Nutrition Facts
- Health Benefits
- Food Types & Varieties
- Culinary Uses
- Vegetables & Produce
- Nuts & Seeds
- Food Categories
- Recipes
- Regional Origins
- Cooking Methods
- Food Reference
- Herbs & Spices
- Substitutes
- North America
- Europe

## Core Reference

- [Only Foods - All About Food!](https://www.onlyfoods.net): Homepage showcasing OnlyFoods.net food guides covering nuts, seeds, and food categories
- [A to Z Lists of Foods With Pictures](https://www.onlyfoods.net/a-to-z-foods): Alphabetical directory of foods with pictures and categorized food reference lists

## Nuts & Seeds Guides

- [Pine Nuts Nutrition Facts, Health Benefits, Substitutes, Pictures](https://www.onlyfoods.net/pine-nuts.html): Pine Nuts nutrition, health benefits, and substitutes with regional varieties
- [Pumpkin Seeds - Only Foods](https://www.onlyfoods.net/pumpkin-seeds.html): Pumpkin Seeds (Pepitas) profile with nutrition, health benefits, and distribution
- [Sesame Seeds - Nutrition Facts, Health Benefits, Recipes, Pictures](https://www.onlyfoods.net/sesame-seeds.html): Sesame Seeds guide with nutrition facts, health benefits, and culinary recipes
- [American Chestnut - Nutrition Facts, Benefits, Uses and Pictures](https://www.onlyfoods.net/american-chestnut.html): American Chestnut nutrition, health benefits, and uses with botanical information

## Vegetable & Produce Varieties

- [30 Different Types of Peppers From Sweet to Mild, and Truly Hot - Only Foods](https://www.onlyfoods.net/types-of-peppers.html): 30 pepper varieties guide with Scoville heat levels and regional origins
- [List of the Different Types of Beans with Pictures](https://www.onlyfoods.net/different-types-of-beans.html): Bean varieties guide with nutrition data, cooking uses, and illustrated profiles
- [12 Types of Cabbage and Their Uses - Only Foods](https://www.onlyfoods.net/types-of-cabbage.html): Cabbage varieties guide with nutrition facts, cooking methods, and uses
- [8 Different Types of Cucumbers and What to Do With Them](https://www.onlyfoods.net/types-of-cucumbers.html): Cucumber varieties guide with pickling, slicing types, and cooking uses
- [8 Different Types of Kale for Salads, Soups, and More](https://www.onlyfoods.net/types-of-kale.html): Kale varieties guide with culinary uses and nutritional content
- [13 Types of Pumpkin to Know About](https://www.onlyfoods.net/types-of-pumpkin.html): Guide to 13 pumpkin varieties and seasonal uses in North America

## Fruits & Beverages

- [20 Different Types of Grapes to Eat and Make Wine](https://www.onlyfoods.net/types-of-grapes.html): Comprehensive guide to 20 grape varieties for eating and winemaking
- [5 Different Types of Wine and Their Tastes You Need to Know About](https://www.onlyfoods.net/types-of-wine.html): Wine guide covering types, tasting profiles, and characteristics from major regions

## Proteins, Oils & Specialty Foods

- [Bacon - Nutrition Facts, Calories, Health Benefits, Uses, Recipes](https://www.onlyfoods.net/bacon.html): Bacon types guide with nutrition facts, calories, health benefits, and recipes
- [Wheat Germ Oil Benefits, Nutrition, Where to Buy](https://www.onlyfoods.net/wheat-germ-oil.html): Wheat Germ Oil guide with vitamin E benefits, nutrition, and shopping information
- [Suluguni - Nutritional Facts, Uses, Recipes and Substitute](https://www.onlyfoods.net/suluguni.html): Georgian Suluguni cheese guide with nutrition, recipes, and substitutes

## Herbs & Specialty Ingredients

- [Summer Savory Health Benefits, Nutrition, Recipes, Substitutes](https://www.onlyfoods.net/summer-savory.html): Summer Savory herb guide with health benefits, recipes, and substitutes
- [Barberry - Types, Medicinal Uses, Nutrition Benefits and Side Effects - Only Foods](https://www.onlyfoods.net/barberry-types-medicinal-uses-nutrition-benefits-and-side-effects.html): Barberry guide with medicinal uses, nutrition benefits, and side effects
- [Chenopodium Album - Only Foods](https://www.onlyfoods.net/chenopodium-album.html): Chenopodium Album (Fat Hen) leafy vegetable profile from Asia and Africa
